operandDomains.policy: every pair in A x B is defined in C++ and exactly modelled; case n draws from domain n modulo the family's domain count

operatorModel.integers: C++ semantics after promotion: two's complement wrap, truncating division, MLX floored remainder and power; undefined pairs excluded
operatorModel.bool: promoted to int, converted back to bool
operatorModel.floatingPoint: IEEE-754 results that need no rounding and are normal or zero; signed zeros and infinities exact; NaN accepts any NaN
operatorModel.float16Remainder: Metal binary16 fmod: x - trunc(x / y) * y in binary32, NaN for non-finite operands or a zero divisor
operatorModel.complex64: complex.h formulas with exact float32 intermediates
operatorModel.selection: Maximum and Minimum return operand bits
operatorModel.transcendental: LogAddExp, ArcTan2 and Power only at exactly defined values
